SHARED-F-2-S8.title: Consent Data Schema and Persistence Model
SHARED-F-2-S8.description: Define and implement MongoDB schema and Pydantic contracts for consent records including tier (Tier 1/Tier 2), timestamps, conversation linkage, and de-identification status. Ensure compatibility with existing lead_capture and consent_service usage.

SHARED-F-2-S9.title: Consent API and Tool Interface
